annotations.title: Edit, end or stop tracking bills

description: Change bills that exist — **a list in one call**. Per entry: `name`, `expected_amount` (the whole charge, major units — a yearly premium is the year’s figure), `cadence`, `category_id` (null clears), `is_discretionary`, `day_of_month` (null clears), `ended_on` (YYYY-MM-DD or "today": it keeps its history and drops out of every plan); or, alone, `stop_tracking: true`, which removes it and what every plan said about it — its charges stay on Transactions. How it is recognised in the ledger is not changed here. Adding is `track_fixed_expenses`; what it does to a plan is `set_fixed_expense_roles`. **Dry-runs by default**; `commit: true` writes. The document is copied to a timestamped .bak first. Ids come from `plans` or `fixed_expenses`.

commit.description: Default false. False previews; true writes.

edits.description: One entry per bill. Up to 100 in a call.

cadence.description: One of MONTHLY, BIMONTHLY, QUARTERLY, YEARLY, IRREGULAR.

category_id.description: A category id, or null to clear.

ended_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD or "today": the day it stopped.

expected_amount.description: The whole recurring charge, major units.

is_discretionary.description: True for a bill that could be cut.

stop_tracking.description: Remove it. Alone in the entry.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

name: edit_fixed_expenses
